source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended October 31, 2026, cover page
source.quote: As of November 19, 2026, the number of shares of the registrant's common stock outstanding was 1,030,596,521 .

notes: Class A common stock, listed on Nasdaq as CRWD; no Class B shares have been outstanding since December 2024. The count (10-Q filed November 23, 2026) is after the four-for-one stock split in the form of a stock dividend, distributed after the close of business on July 1, 2026 to holders of record on June 25, 2026.
